fusions.name: Barbed Cast
fusions.desc: A cast jaw that deals 30 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range, plus 5% of a boss or elite enemy's maximum health.

fusions.name: Quick Gaff
fusions.desc: Flicks a gaff that deals 4 damage and has a 30% chance of making the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagging Call
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sharpened Barbs
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 10%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
